findings.title: RSA key generation detected
findings.description: This code generates RSA private keys using the cryptography library. RSA relies on classical public-key cryptography and should be included in a post-quantum migration inventory.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate protocol-compatible migration options. ML-DSA (FIPS 204) is relevant for digital signatures; ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for key establishment.

findings.title: MD5 hash function usage detected
findings.description: MD5 is a cryptographically broken hash function. It should not be used for security-sensitive purposes.
findings.recommendation: Replace MD5 with SHA-256 or SHA-3 for integrity verification. MD5 is not suitable for password hashing — use bcrypt or Argon2.
